purpose: The patch makes fwnode APIs accept error pointers by adding IS_ERR_OR_NULL checks and adjusting macros, so callers no longer need separate error handling, preventing reference‑count and crash bugs.
Updates the QMP PHY devicetree binding YAML to correct the child‑node description from per‑lane to per‑PHY, fixing an inaccurate documentation statement.
Adds core data structures, driver functions, DMUB command definitions, and debug options needed to support Firmware Assisted Memory Switching (FAMS) in AMD display driver.
Adds conditional compilation guards around x86‑specific code in ttm_module.c so the DRM TTM driver builds on User‑Mode Linux (ARCH=um), avoiding compile errors from undefined boot_cpu_data.
Adds const qualifier to static arrays of struct qcom_icc_bcm pointers in the sc8280xp interconnect driver, making the pointers immutable for safety.
Adds CONFIG_32BIT guards to SBI PMU ecall arguments so that 64‑bit values are split correctly on RV32, fixing incorrect argument passing for counter configuration and start.
The patch replaces direct struct cpu map accesses in perf tools with the perf_cpu_map API, using helper functions and iterators to improve safety and consistency.
Adds DMA allocation/free tracepoints, passes caller name to tracing, and introduces wrapper macros to expose this tracing capability.

Refactors the cs42l42 driver by splitting probe/remove into bus‑specific, common, and register‑initialisation stages, adds common_probe/init/remove helpers, introduces an init_done flag and irq field, and updates the I2C probe flow to support future SoundWire integration.
Adds a device‑tree entry for the Qualcomm SC7280 Data Capture and Compare (DCC) hardware, defining its compatible strings and register address ranges.

The patch replaces direct casts from const pointers to void* with casts via uintptr_t (or removes unnecessary casts) to avoid dropping the const qualifier, fixing compiler warnings on strict systems and ensuring proper de‑const handling in iwlwifi driver code.

Refactors the vfio_ap driver to retrieve queue devices using the AP bus's ap_get_qdev() hash‑table lookup instead of iterating over the device list with driver_find_device, removing the match function and improving lookup efficiency.
Fixes NFSv4.2 CLONE handling where a zero-length clone incorrectly set the destination inode size to zero by computing the correct count from the server's reported size after GETATTR.
Adds a static inline get_snr() function to extract SNR from the wcn36xx receive descriptor, enabling future use in mac80211 survey operations.
The patch replaces partial bio initialization with full bio_init calls, removes the pre‑allocation loop, and switches bio_reset to bio_uninit, ensuring bios are correctly set up only when needed.
Removes an unnecessary line‑continuation backslash in the intel_idle driver’s spr_cstates definition, cleaning up the source without altering functionality.

Adds CONFIG_OBJTOOL as a new Kconfig option, replaces most CONFIG_STACK_VALIDATION checks with CONFIG_OBJTOOL, and updates Makefile, Kconfig files, source conditionals, scripts, and packaging to use the new flag, refactoring the build configuration for objtool.

The patch corrects endianness type mismatches in moxart_ether.c by changing descriptor pointers from u32 to __le32 and using cpu_to_le32/le32_to_cpu, eliminating sparse warnings and ensuring proper byte order handling.
The commit corrects a misspelled word in the SCSI documentation ChangeLog, changing "caste" to "cast", fixing a typo.
The commit updates the imx fracn GPPLL rate table, changing the mfd field from 0 to 1 for several entries to comply with hardware spec that disallows a zero value.

The patch corrects kill_accessing_process() to return -EHWPOISON when a page is already poisoned, fixing the wrong -EFAULT return that caused duplicate SIGBUS signals and misleading "Memory error not recovered" messages.
Modifies the snvs-lpgpr devicetree binding YAML to document that i.MX8M compatible strings also contain the fallback "fsl,imx7d-snvs-lpgpr" by using a oneOf schema.
The patch deletes an unnecessary dev_err call in the aspeed SPI driver because devm_ioremap_resource already reports errors, simplifying the probe function.
Adds mrouter port support to the sparx5 driver: new is_mrouter flag, multicast flood handling, switchdev attribute, MDB updates, and PGID clear function.

The patch renames the driver’s main data structure from xilinx_pcie_port to xilinx_pcie and updates all related references, comments, and function signatures. It introduces no functional changes, only a naming convention adjustment.
Removes an unused variable and a verbose dev_vdbg call from the QMP combo PHY init function, cleaning up code.
The commit replaces the legacy .txt device‑tree binding for a GPIO‑based IR LED transmitter with a new YAML schema file, deletes the old file, and updates MAINTAINERS to reference the YAML file.

The patch rewrites unx_lookup_cred() to allocate the rpc_cred structure with kmalloc using the task's GFP mask, falling back to the existing mempool only for asynchronous lookups, and returns proper error pointers. This aligns allocation with rpc_malloc() behavior.
Adds two compatible strings (lenovo,thinkpad-x13s and qcom,sc8280xp-crd) to the QCOM devicetree bindings YAML, documenting additional sc8280xp devices.
Adds a device‑tree node for the Qualcomm SM8150 ethqos Ethernet controller, specifying compatible string, registers, clocks, interrupts, power domain, resets, IOMMU, and related properties.
Replaces a manual shift expression and explicit cast with the PAGE_SECTORS_SHIFT macro in read_part_sector, improving readability without altering behavior.
Switches the DASD sysfs kobj_type from default_attrs to default_groups, adds ATTRIBUTE_GROUPS macro, and removes the obsolete field, aligning with the newer kobject API.

The patch replaces manual read‑modify‑write sequences in DVO enable/disable with the generic intel_de_rmw() helper and uses intel_de_posting_read() for the required posting read, simplifying the code and using the standard register access utilities.
Deletes the hisilicon,hi6220-reset binding doc because the related controllers are already described in other binding files, removing duplicate/obsolete documentation.
Reverts the earlier commit that set num_pipe_per_me to 2, restoring it to 1 for specific GPU IP versions to stop graphics hangs on Navi 21 with GNOME Wayland.
Adds a wrapper struct to hold the __iomem register base, allocates it, stores it in cfg->priv, and updates map_bus to use the struct, eliminating sparse address‑space conversion warnings.
Adds CRIU support to report AMD KFD SVM ranges by implementing svm_range_get_info, extending PROCESS_INFO ioctl, and defining struct fields for SVM range data.

Adds a new boolean field submission_initialized to intel_guc, replaces the previous reliance on the LRC descriptor pool pointer as an init flag, updates checks and init/fini paths to set/clear this flag, ensuring correct tracking after the pool is removed.

Adds riscv_insn_valid_32bit_offset to correctly validate the true 32‑bit PC‑relative range for auipc+jalr ([-2^31‑2^11, 2^31‑2^11)). Replaces previous simple s32 cast check in relocation handling, fixing mis‑handled edge offsets.
Adds error handling in davinci_mmcsd_resume: captures clk_enable return value, returns the error if it fails, ensuring proper handling of clock enable failures during resume.
Adds missing asterisks in comment blocks of trace_events_hist.c to fix clang warnings; only comment changes, no functional impact.
Expands the char name array in exynos_mct driver from 10 to 11 bytes and adds a comment, allowing correct printing of timer identifiers on CPUs with 12 or more local timers.

Adjusts KVM PowerPC HV handling of the decrementer during VM migration by initializing dec_expires relative to the guest timebase when the timebase offset is set, and removes the previous unconditional initialization.

The patch moves IO flag handling from the f2fs_io_info structure to the bio, introducing f2fs_io_flags() to compute REQ_META/REQ_FUA based on filesystem settings, and merges these flags when allocating the bio to avoid splitting IOs.
Replaces redundant PageCompound+order check with PageHead in compound_range_next, simplifying logic and removing unnecessary test.

The commit removes the HAL_DEF_IS_SUPPORT_ANT_DIV case from GetHalDefVar8188EUsb, deletes the corresponding enum entry, and adds a new helper rtw_antenna_diversity that checks AntDivCfg directly, streamlining antenna‑diversity handling and eliminating an unnecessary HAL layer.
The patch fixes the DSC register programming by using the correct 6.4‑bit bits_per_pixel value directly, removing erroneous fractional‑bit extraction logic.
The script now uses the built‑in perf workload "thloop" instead of compiling a custom C test program, removing the need for a compiler and simplifying the test harness.

Adds a check in hci_cmd_sync_queue to return -ENODEV when the HCI_UNREGISTER flag is set, preventing commands from being queued after the device is being unregistered, which could cause a use‑after‑free.

The patch adds a likely() branch prediction hint to the check for ICE_XDP_TX or ICE_XDP_REDIR in ice_run_xdp_zc, restructures the conditional flow, and moves common bookkeeping (byte/packet counters and NTC bump) out of the conditional. This aims to improve compiler optimization and runtime performance of the XDP zero‑copy path.

The patch changes arp_invalidate to accept a force flag and calls it from fib_add_ifaddr to drop stale unicast neighbour entries for broadcast addresses when broadcast routes are added, eliminating packet drops caused by those entries.
Removes the unnecessary #include <asm/termios.h> from drivers/tty/n_hdlc.c because linux/tty.h already pulls in the required termios definitions, simplifying the file's includes.
The patch changes brcmstb_reset() from global to static, eliminating a -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warning without altering runtime behavior.

The patch deletes all guest PASID related UAPI functions, structs, and driver callbacks from the IOMMU subsystem, as they are unused and will be replaced by the new iommufd design, cleaning dead code.
The patch updates the moxart MMC driver to store the return value of mmc_add_host(). On failure it jumps to error handling that frees the allocated host, preventing a memory leak and kernel crash.

The commit fixes a build failure on 32‑bit (i386) kernels where the compiler emitted an undefined reference to __umoddi3 by replacing the direct modulo operation with the kernel helper div_u64_rem, adding a remainder variable.

The patch removes the storage of MACsec encryption keys in the flow structure, passing the key directly to the transformation routine and deleting the key field and related copies. It also drops the explicit zeroing on flow free.

Switches packet buffer allocation in vhost/vsock and virtio_transport from kmalloc/kfree to kvmalloc/kvfree to avoid allocation failures for large (≈32 KB) packets, fixing SFTP over vsock transfer failures.

The patch changes the dp83822 PHY driver to stop enabling the RX error high‑frequency interrupt. When the RCSR register fills, this interrupt floods the system, and the driver never clears it. Disabling the interrupt stops the flood.
Adds the compatible string "aries,m100pfsevp" to the Microchip RISC‑V devicetree bindings YAML, documenting support for the Aries Embedded M100PFSEVP SOM/EVK platform.

Adds runtime DSP path handling for Intel AVS ASoC driver: new path.c implements creation, variant selection, pipeline/module/binding allocation and cleanup; updates Makefile, avs_dev struct, and header declarations to support path management during PCM hw_params and hw_free.
Detects Vega20 GPUs with XGMI bridges and forces a TLB flush after page‑table updates because PTEs may be cached in the texture cache, causing stalls. Adds a condition to set the flush flag.
Adds support for the Allwinner H616 USB PHY by defining a new configuration struct with its specific quirks and registering a compatible device tree entry.
Adds a new eDP panel entry for IVO M133NW4J-R3 in the panel-edp driver, using the delay_200_500_p2e100 timing table due to lack of documentation.
Renames the KVM self‑test file evmcs_test to hyperv_evmcs and updates .gitignore and Makefile entries accordingly, aligning the naming with other Hyper‑V tests.
Adds the static keyword to the I2C and SPI of_device_id match tables in the Arizona MFD driver, making them file‑local now that they are no longer exported.

Adds infrastructure for KPP template instances: defines struct kpp_instance, free handling, registration primitive, helper casts and context access, and documents them, enabling future template‑based key‑agreement algorithms.

The commit reorders operations in the i.MX RNG driver: it clears the interrupt mask before registering the IRQ handler, preventing handling of a stale SEED_DONE interrupt that could complete the RNG operation prematurely and crash the kernel during boot.

The commit cleans up the QMP PHY device‑tree binding documentation by removing redundant description fields for supply, clock, and reset properties and replacing them with concise boolean or maxItems specifications, reducing duplication and improving readability.

Updates the ADI ADC device‑tree binding documentation: adds AD7927 to the description, restructures the compatible property with oneOf, deprecates AD7924, and documents the relationship between AD7923 and AD7924.
The commit raises the reported maximum LED brightness for the Dream Cheeky Webmail Notifier from 31 to 63 in the hid-led driver, correcting the value based on empirical testing.
Adds a default case to mvebu_pcie_hw_rd_conf() that returns 0xffffffff and PCIBIOS_BAD_REGISTER_NUMBER for unsupported read sizes, mirroring the write path handling.

The patch removes the local bit_reverse implementation from lib/packing.c, replaces its usage with the kernel-provided bitrev8() macro, adds the BITREVERSE config option, and adjusts the shift logic accordingly, simplifying the code and avoiding duplication.

The patch reorders TLB handling in LoongArch: calls local_flush_tlb_all() right after setup_ptwalker() and before page allocation, and moves output_pgtable_bits_defines() into tlb_init(). This prevents stale TLB entries that caused the second kernel of kexec/kdump to fail booting SMP.

Introduces a cache for backref sharedness checks in btrfs fiemap, adds structs and helper functions, updates snapshot drop handling, and integrates the cache into extent_fiemap to avoid repeated expensive lookups, resulting in significant performance gains.
Adds the 'N/A' store metric to the perf c2c documentation, explaining its meaning for store reference and store refs and updating the report table description.

Moves the machine‑dependent RTC PLL function pointers and hwclk definition from setup files to time.c, ensuring they are compiled for nommu classic m68k builds, fixing undefined reference errors when CONFIG_RTC_DRV_GENERIC is enabled.
Adds a helper to free enclosure device structures and invokes it during driver unload and controller reset, preventing resource leaks.
Fixes race and lock handling in hugetlb VMA operations, allocating a new vma lock on split, adjusting unmap handling, and ensuring lock presence for shared mappings.
Enables switching to a different time namespace during a vfork+exec sequence by adjusting exec handling and fork checks, avoiding the need for a new clone flag.
The patch eliminates the per‑CPU dying list, moves dying entries to a per‑net list, and adjusts when IPS_CONFIRMED is set to avoid double unlinking during conntrack destruction.
The commit corrects a duplicated word in a comment within ab8500_fg.c, changing "is is" to "is".
The commit extends the DesignWare PCI I2C driver to obtain I2C timing parameters from firmware by calling i2c_parse_fw_timings(), replacing the previous hard‑coded default frequency.
The commit adds a macro DISABLE_XENPV that disables the X86_FEATURE_XENPV bit unless CONFIG_XEN_PV is set, and incorporates it into DISABLED_MASK8, extending the disabled‑features handling.

Adds a CPU feature flag X86_FEATURE_RETHUNK and code to replace compiler‑generated return‑thunk jumps with plain RET instructions on CPUs where the thunk causes problems, effectively undoing the previous mitigation.
Adds AVDD-supply and MICVDD-supply properties to the rt5682s device‑tree binding YAML, documenting required regulators and updating the required list and example.

The patch removes redundant resetting of control arrays in set_mba_sc() and adds resetting of mbps_val[] in reset_all_ctrls(), simplifying the resctrl code and ensuring defaults are set only where needed.

The patch renames the vkms_composer struct to vkms_frame_info throughout the vkms driver, updating all references, comments, and allocation handling. It also mentions a fix to iosys_map_is_null verification, but the diff only shows the rename.
The patch updates fbcon sysfs attribute show functions to use sysfs_emit instead of snprintf, aligning with kernel sysfs conventions and simplifying buffer handling.
Removes assignments to udc->dev.driver in the USB gadget core to stop a race condition that caused a use‑after‑free in dev_uevent, fixing the bug reported by syzbot.
Adds missing iounmap() in zorro7xx_remove_one() to release I/O memory mapping allocated during probe, fixing a resource leak.
Renames the .set_fmt_new field back to .set_fmt in the jz4740 I2S driver to match the core's new direct clock API, keeping the same implementation function.

Moves the non‑AP handling of disassociation to the top of OnDisassoc, returning early, and restructures the AP‑specific block, removing the else branch, to simplify and clarify the logic in the r8188eu driver.

Introduces intel_async_flip_check_uapi to perform early async‑flip capability checks (CRTC active, modeset required, plane enabled) and restructures the existing async‑flip hardware check, moving validation earlier in the atomic path.

The patch removes kernel-doc comment blocks (/** ... */) from static functions in drm_edid.c and replaces them with regular C comments, preserving the explanatory text but dropping the kernel-doc markup.

Switches the spear-keyboard driver to use DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS with pm_sleep_ptr, removing __maybe_unused from suspend/resume functions to avoid deprecated macro warnings and let the compiler drop unused code.
Adds an inline helper rdma_get_udp_sport that computes a UDP source port from a GRH flow label, falling back to a derived label using local/remote QP numbers.

Adds support for an on‑board RT711 SDCA audio codec on MeteorLake (MTL) platforms by extending DMI quirk table and defining ACPI endpoint/ADR structures, then registering a new machine entry with appropriate topology template.

Converts the firmware‑aware MCR wait function to manage the uncore lock internally, renames it, and updates its sole callsite, eliminating a race condition where the lock was not held and avoiding holding the lock during long waits.
Adds support for a new AMD PMC controller version by defining a new CPU ID, handling it in various code paths, and registering its PCI and ACPI IDs.
The patch updates the r8188eu driver to replace a driver‑specific get_da call with the generic ieee80211_get_DA helper, adjusting the code to use the ieee80211_hdr pointer from the received frame.
Adds a new compatible string elan,ekth3915 for the Elan eth3915n touchscreen controller in the devicetree binding documentation, allowing the kernel to match this hardware.
The patch replaces scnprintf with sysfs_emit in two mcdi_logging_show functions to follow sysfs guidelines for formatting data returned to userspace.

Adds support for Intel LBR format V7 by introducing capability flags, initializing them at boot, and simplifying LBR capability checks, enabling correct handling of LBR_INFO on Goldmont plus and Tremont CPUs.
The patch removes the redundant LED_871x struct and merges its fields into led_priv, updating all references in rtw_led.c and rtw_led.h. This simplifies the LED handling code in the r8188eu driver.

The commit changes a 64‑bit read (nn_readq) of a 32‑bit capability word to a 32‑bit read (nn_readl) because the address is not qword aligned, preventing architecture‑specific unaligned access exceptions.
Adds validation in nf_tables_newset to require the NFT_SET_CONCAT flag when a set specifies multiple fields and to reject the flag when no field_count is given, returning -EINVAL.
The commit updates the kernel Makefile to reflect the 6.2 release candidate: increments PATCHLEVEL to 2, sets EXTRAVERSION to '-rc1', and changes the NAME string.
Reverts the restrictive APIC‑write check in kvm_apic_write_nodecode, allowing non‑ICR MSR writes in x2APIC mode and restoring x2AVIC support.

The patch corrects the length check in tipc_nl_compat_name_table_dump_header by casting sizeof to int, ensuring proper signed comparison when TLV_GET_DATA_LEN can be negative, fixing a KMSAN-reported uninitialized‑value bug.
Adds a compatible property to the Stratix10 SoC Development Kit device tree files, allowing the kernel to recognize and support this board.
Adds avdd-0v9-supply and avdd-1v8-supply properties to the HDMI node in the rk3399-roc-pc device tree and renames the 1.8 V regulator node to match the schematic, eliminating a kernel dmesg warning.
Renames the KUnit test configuration symbols for the IIO formatting test to follow the required CONFIG_<name>_KUNIT_TEST pattern, updating both Kconfig and Makefile entries.
Updates KVM arm64 self‑test to disable single‑step by setting debug.control = KVM_GUESTDBG_ENABLE instead of SINGLE_STEP_DISABLE, correcting the constant used; no functional change.

The commit replaces the legacy qcom,gsbi.txt device‑tree binding documentation with a new DT schema file qcom,gsbi.yaml, deleting the old text file and adding the YAML schema with properties, examples, and metadata.

The patch refactors the SCSI disk driver’s DIF/DIX handling by separating protection type reading from configuration, removing a redundant call to sd_revalidate_disk during device discovery, and simplifying log messages, so the integrity probing runs only once.
Enables audio on the RZ/G2UL SMARC board by adding SSI1 pinmux entries and linking the SSI1 DAI to the CPU DAI in the device tree, with conditional status handling for the audio nodes.

The commit removes the hard‑coded IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING flag from ath10k SNOC driver, allowing the interrupt trigger type to be defined by the device tree, fixing bind failures on Qualcomm WCN3990 hardware.
Reverts a recent change that added an incorrect __user qualifier to the buffer argument of proc_dointvec_minmax_sysadmin(), restoring the correct void * type to eliminate sparse warnings.

Adds interrupt support to the Microchip PCI1xxxx GPIO driver by including interrupt header, defining register offsets, implementing IRQ ack, mask, unmask, set_type functions, an IRQ handler, and registering an irq_chip with the GPIO subsystem.
Removes the unused 'work' field from struct mlx5e_async_ctx in the Mellanox mlx5e kTLS TX driver; no functional change, just dead code cleanup.
The commit corrects rxrpc congestion management by stopping the reuse of a zero cwnd, resetting to initial cwnd after idle > RTT, preserving ssthresh, and adding related fields and trace events.
Moves three root helper inline functions from accessors.h to ctree.h, aligning them with btrfs_root definitions and simplifying header synchronization with btrfs‑progs.
Adds support for SMUIO block version 13.0.9 by extending the IP version switch to assign the existing SMUIO function table, enabling the driver to recognize and use this new hardware block.
The commit raises the max average DRAM bandwidth usage limit for DCN315 from 30% to 60% to satisfy DML validation when multiple HDR displays are connected, matching the value used for DCN31.

The commit corrects the 4 GB boundary check in the mpt3sas driver by using DMA addresses instead of virtual addresses, updating the helper function signature and all call sites to pass the DMA address fields.
Adds a new device‑tree binding property `us-euro-gpios` for selecting CTIA/OMTP headset via a GPIO, updating the documentation accordingly.
Fixes a use‑after‑free bug in mlx5e_fs_init() by calling mlx5e_fs_vlan_free(fs) before kvfree(fs) on error paths, ensuring resources are released in correct order.

The patch restores proper peer cleanup when a station disconnects on QCA6390/WCN6855. It re‑introduces the peer delete call except when a hardware‑specific flag indicates the WMI_PEER_DELETE_CMDID should be skipped, and clears the stale peer->sta pointer to avoid use‑after‑free.
The commit deletes the unused rxrpc_kernel_get_reply_time function, its prototype, and documentation because the call issue time is now used, eliminating dead code from the RxRPC subsystem.

The commit updates the maintainer email address in three devicetree binding YAML files, replacing the old personal address with the preferred Bootlin address, thereby correcting documentation metadata.
Fixes error handling in mpfs_probe(): adds proper negative error codes (-ENOMEM, PTR_ERR) for allocation and PHY registration failures, correcting previously returning success.

The commit moves netdev notifier registration from each device probe to module initialization, preventing duplicate registrations when multiple ADIN1110/2111 devices are present, thus eliminating probe warnings and failures.
Removes the inefficient jfs_writepage function and sets ->migrate_folio to the generic buffer_migrate_folio helper, updating JFS address_space_operations accordingly.

Adds support for a new firmware queue allocation command (SCD_QUEUE_CONFIG_CMD), introduces related enums and structs, updates driver configuration, adapts API to use station masks, and ensures queues are removed before stations as required by newer firmware.

Adds a helper library function virt_get_pte_hva() to KVM aarch64 self‑tests, exposing the host virtual address of a page‑table entry for a given guest virtual address, and updates addr_arch_gva2gpa to use it.
The commit removes deprecated perf buffer APIs, deletes compatibility wrappers, simplifies option structs, and updates the symbol map, cleaning up libbpf's perf buffer interface.
Adds support for Fiero SC-01 USB audio devices with firmware v1.0.0 (48 kHz and 96 kHz) by introducing corresponding quirks and flag entries, mirroring the existing handling for firmware v1.1.0.
Removes the io_run_task_work() call at the start of the io_uring_enter syscall, deferring task work until after submissions to improve batching and reduce unnecessary work.
Rewrites OMAP3 clock nodes in DTS files to use the generic ti,clksel binding and adds clock-output-names, eliminating unique-unit-address and node-name warnings.
The commit corrects a misspelled word in a comment within fs/ocfs2/quota_global.c, changing "exlusive" to "exclusive" without altering any code logic.
The patch rewrites try_to_free_swap to operate on a folio instead of a page, adding folio_swapped and using folio_test_* macros, removing compound_head calls, and shrinking kernel text by 74 bytes.
Changes cfg80211_auth_request.key_idx from unsigned u8 to signed s8 so that a sentinel value -1 can be used when the key pointer is NULL, eliminating static analysis warnings.

Adds a bool reset argument to mtk_wed_tx_ring_setup and mtk_wed_wdma_rx_ring_setup, updates callers and header macros, and adjusts allocation logic to skip ring allocation when resetting. Prepares the driver for future Wireless Ethernet Dispatcher reset functionality.
Adds CAP_SYS_ADMIN checks to NVMe management ioctls (RESET, SUBSYS_RESET, RESCAN) so only privileged users can invoke disruptive operations.
Adds support for restoring the original SDMA queue identifier during CRIU checkpoint/restore by passing an optional sdma_id through queue creation paths and allocating it if provided.
The patch removes the HW_VAR_AC_PARAM_VI enum and its handling in SetHwReg8188EU(), replacing it with a direct rtw_write32() call to REG_EDCA_VI_PARAM, simplifying the driver code.
Replaces snprintf calls in MHI sysfs attribute show functions with sysfs_emit/sysfs_emit_at to satisfy Coccinelle checks and use the proper sysfs helper.
Reorganizes OMAP3 clock nodes in the device tree, grouping them under a ti,clksel node and adding clock-output-names to eliminate unique_unit_address and node_name_chars_strict warnings.

The commit introduces a new pinctrl/GPIO driver for Intel Meteor Lake platforms, adding Kconfig and Makefile entries and a large source file defining pins, pad groups, and ACPI matching to enable hardware support.

The commit extracts QCS404 peripheral authentication service device‑tree bindings from the generic ADSP bindings file into a dedicated qcom,qcs404-pas.yaml file, removing those entries from qcom,adsp.yaml and adding the new file with the full schema and examples.
Adds 'clocks' and 'clock-names' entries to the SDM845 camera clock controller devicetree binding documentation, indicating support for the bi-tcxo clock.
Changes dsa_switch.num_ports from size_t to unsigned int, reducing struct size and eliminating padding; updates dev_err format string to match the new type.
Removes unnecessary chip‑type comments from the FTDI USB‑serial driver, cleaning up the source without changing any functionality.

The patch refactors address attribute checking in the RXE driver: introduces a generic chk_attr helper, splits rxe_av_chk_attr into qp‑specific and ah‑specific versions, updates callers, and replaces generic pr_warn messages with context‑aware rxe_dbg_* logging. Header declarations are updated accordingly.

The patch modifies amdgpu_ras_feature_enable to allocate and send RAS enable/disable commands only when the block is GFX, adding a block check and adjusting cleanup, thus correcting the previous unconditional handling.
The commit removes Jukka Rissanen from the MAINTAINERS file for the 6lowpan subsystem, reflecting his departure from the project.
Initializes the variable 'next' to NULL in find_first_clear_extent_bit, removing a compile-time uninitialized variable error.

Adds tracking of CPU‑visible memory in the i915 TTM buddy allocator, introducing visible size/available/reserved counters, updating them on allocations, frees and reserves, exposing a helper to query visible size, and adjusting init to accept the visible size parameter.

Introduces a mechanism for CXL.mem drivers to enumerate ancestor CXL switch ports, track endpoint interest, handle race conditions, and clean up ports, plus refactors dport lookup into a shared helper.
The patch deletes the deprecated function fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption() and its prototype after all callers have been switched to newer APIs, cleaning up dead code in the fscrypt subsystem.

The patch migrates initialization of the hisi-acc VFIO PCI driver to the new device life‑cycle helpers, adds a migration‑specific init callback, selects ops in probe based on VF ID, and removes the now‑unused vfio_pci_core_init/uninit helpers.

The patch removes the unnecessary orig_bio and clone parameters from submit_stripe_bio, derives orig_bio from the btrfs_io_context, decides cloning based on the stripe index, and updates the call site, simplifying the function signature and logic.

The patch rewrites the pinmux configuration tables for the Renesas r8a77470 pinctrl driver, replacing explicit zero entries for reserved bits with shorthand notation using negative field widths and merging consecutive reserved fields, thereby shrinking the compiled driver size.
Reorders the conditional chain in read_clock_frequency so that newer graphics versions (>=11) are handled first, simplifying future extensions and improving code clarity.
Updates the self‑test header to reflect recent kernel changes by expanding vmcb_control_area with SEV‑ES field and reserved space, enabling tests of new virtualization features.

Removes the buddy prefetch logic from free_pcppages_bulk in mm/page_alloc, deleting the prefetch_buddy helper and related code, because the prefetch adds overhead and offers marginal benefit when the zone lock is held.

Adds a new self‑test (bhrb_no_crash_wo_pmu_test) and updates the Makefile to include it, verifying that enabling PERF_SAMPLE_BRANCH_STACK does not crash on platforms without a PMU or with generic_compat_pmu.
The init function now captures the return value of driver_register, and on failure it unregisters the platform driver before returning the error, correcting missing error handling.

The patch introduces a static serial_rs485 structure describing the RS‑485 capabilities of the MAX310x UART and assigns it to the port's rs485_supported field during probe, thereby exposing supported features to the serial core.

The patch refactors the MMU V1 driver by replacing per‑hop address helper functions with a generic one that uses the hop mask/shift arrays, adds a MAX_HOPS macro, and rewrites map/unmap logic to iterate over hops, removing duplicated code.

The patch replaces a dev_warn with dev_dbg in the Qualcomm thermal driver when devm_thermal_of_zone_register() returns -ENODEV, indicating the sensor is unused. This lowers log verbosity by demoting the message to debug level.

The patch replaces the hard‑coded 1000 ms timeout in udl_get_edid_block with the USB_CTRL_GET_TIMEOUT constant (5 seconds), making the driver use the standard USB control‑message timeout for EDID reads.

Adds a guard in gfxhub_v3_0_3_init_system_aperture_regs to return early when running as an SR‑IOV virtual function, skipping programming of system aperture registers that are no longer accessible; these registers are now programmed by the host.

The patch deletes the 'released' atomic field from intel_vgpu and removes its initialization and sanity‑check code in open/close paths, because VFIO core already handles the lifecycle, making the field redundant.

The patch deletes the obsolete arch_has_empty_bitmaps flag from the resctrl cache structure, removes its initialization for Intel and AMD, and updates CBM validation to rely on min_cbm_bits, adding documentation that a zero value means zero CBM is supported.

Introduces a helper function amdgpu_ras_query_poison_mode that encapsulates poison‑mode detection logic, adds early exit for SRIOV guests, and refactors amdgpu_ras_init to call this function, simplifying the code.
Changes ata_port::fastdrain_cnt from unsigned long to unsigned int because it is only ever assigned from 32‑bit values, matching usage and reducing size.

The commit changes the is_partially_uptodate API from page‑based to folio‑based, updates return type to bool, adjusts documentation, and modifies all callers (buffer.c, iomap, filemap) to use folio semantics and byte counts.

The commit reorders the CONFIG_SURFACE_PLATFORMS entry in two RISC‑V defconfig files to match the ordering produced by savedefconfig, removing the original line and thereby only affecting file layout without changing kernel behaviour.
Corrects the selection of the microengine (me) and engine selector for the MAP_QUEUES packet based on the ring type, fixing incorrect handling that could send packets to the wrong engine.

The patch updates traceon/traceoff trigger handlers to detect if a trigger is associated with a specific trace_event_file and, when present, toggle tracing on that instance's tracer instead of the global tracing state, fixing the previous global‑only behavior.
Adds inline helper mcp251xfd_is_fd_mode() and replaces direct ctrlmode checks with calls to it, improving code readability and maintainability.

The patch deletes the setns_by_fd helper that performed a series of mount/unmount operations when switching network namespaces in BPF selftests, replacing it with a direct setns call and fd close, simplifying the code.

The patch replaces direct access to plane->state with the drm_atomic_get_new_plane_state() helper in the SSD130x driver, also renames the atomic state parameter. No functional changes, only API usage correction.

The patch removes the bool sysregs_loaded_on_cpu from kvm_vcpu_arch, adds a generic state flag SYSREGS_ON_CPU, and updates all related code to use vcpu_get/set/clear_flag, improving consistency and reducing per‑vcpu storage.
Adds a forward declaration for struct folio in include/linux/cacheflush.h to eliminate implicit‑declaration warnings for code that includes this header.
The patch relaxes a validation check in mt7921_mac_fill_rx, changing the limit from MCS index >9 to >11, allowing reception of VHT MCS10‑11 frames that the hardware can handle.

Adds a syscon binding and a clk-phase-sd-hs property to the SDMMC node in device‑tree files for Stratix10, Agilex and N5X platforms, allowing the driver to adjust the CIU clock phase via the system manager.
Adds a call to free(params) before exiting osnoise_top, releasing the memory allocated for parsed command‑line arguments that was previously leaked.
Adds firmware command for DRR manual trigger, updates SubVP pipe control to avoid locking for DRR VSYNC flips, and integrates these changes into the timing generator functions for DCN32/321.

The commit renames the reference‑counting helpers in the RXE driver from rxe_add_ref/rxe_drop_ref to rxe_get/rxe_put, updates the macro definitions in rxe_pool.h, and replaces all call sites accordingly, improving code readability without altering functionality.
Adds swap_free(entry) when arch_unmap_one fails, undoing a prior swap_duplicate to prevent leaked swap cache entries and memory corruption in try_to_unmap.

Adds support for exposing Cirrus Logic CS_DSP DSP controls as ALSA controls. Introduces a new Kconfig option, makefile entry, and implements a library (hda_cs_dsp_ctl.c/h) that creates ALSA kcontrols for DSP coefficient controls.
Updates the kernel version string in Makefile from -rc5 to -rc6, marking the next release candidate.

The patch modifies tdp_mmu_set_spte_atomic to capture the value returned by cmpxchg when it fails and store it in iter->old_spte, removing the need for callers to manually reload the SPTE. Call sites are updated accordingly, simplifying the code and ensuring they operate on fresh data.
Adds optional clock handling to the Hisilicon I2C driver: obtains a clk object, uses its rate, and falls back to the legacy clk_rate property, updating the driver struct accordingly.
Adds a variable to capture the end address of a GAP hole and prints its size (as number of address bits) in the kernel log, enhancing diagnostics for the UV platform.
Initializes the missing vqs_list_lock in vdev_info_init, preventing virtio_test from hanging due to an uninitialized spin lock.

Implements a new hot‑page selection algorithm for NUMA memory tiering by recording scan timestamps in struct page, computing hint‑page‑fault latency, and using a configurable hot‑threshold to decide promotion. Adds sysctl/debugfs entry, reuses page bits, and updates migration logic accordingly.
Adds a Chinese translation of Documentation/Devicetree/changesets.rst and updates the Chinese devicetree index to list the new file.
Adjusts the cast used in LSE atomic compare‑exchange macros to use a size‑matched type (u##sz) instead of unsigned long, eliminating -Warray-bounds warnings without altering generated code.

The commit moves the extract‑cert helper from scripts/ to certs/, updates MAINTAINERS, .gitignore, certs/Makefile and scripts/Makefile, adds host build rules, and removes the old script, making the tool built on demand. No kernel runtime code is changed.
Allows changing the MTU of a stmmac Ethernet interface while it is up by restarting the driver and reinitializing the DMA configuration, removing the previous requirement to bring the interface down.

Moves the pmu_ops pointer from kvm_x86_ops to kvm_x86_init_ops and marks the pmu_ops structures as __initdata, reducing init‑time memory and making the ops unreachable after initialization to avoid post‑init modifications.
Removes an erroneous MAINTAINERS entry for max77693.txt that was re‑added by a merge conflict, restoring the correct list of documentation files.
The commit updates the QCOM SM8350 pinctrl devicetree binding YAML to make the 'function' property required only for GPIO pins, removing the unconditional requirement and adding a conditional schema.

Adds a self‑test that reproduces a BTF decl_tag misuse causing a WARN_ON_ONCE, verifying that loading such BTF fails with “Invalid return type”. The change inserts raw BTF definitions and expected error into the BPF self‑tests.
Adds checks to selftest RTC code to skip tests when the RTC device file is absent, preventing false test failures on platforms without RTC.
The commit updates fbtft_init_display() to use fbtft_par_dbg_hex() for printing init sequence values, correctly handling the s16 type instead of the previous generic hex dump.
Adds a completion to net_device_context and synchronizes VF registration with host association, preventing a race that could break the VF data path during VM boot.

Ensures the mm_struct stays referenced while processing deferred SVM range work, adding mmget when queuing ranges and releasing after handling, and moving list removal inside mmap lock to avoid use‑after‑free and race bugs.
Adds optional prepare_streaming and unprepare_streaming callbacks to videobuf2, updates counters, calls them in streamon/streamoff paths, and documents the new ops.
Ensures that when the authentication app starts, any existing N2N session is cleared and the link reset, preventing remote devices from logging in with stale state.
Adds buffer reference counting and synchronization to snd_rawmidi_drain_output, checks validity before draining, and waits for refcount zero on close to avoid races with buffer resize.

The patch relocates two helper functions (find_first_clear_extent_bit and lock_extent_bits) from extent_io.c to extent-io-tree.c, adds a missing header, and deletes the original definitions, consolidating all exported extent_io_tree helpers in one file.
Adds a __vcpu_run() inline helper that wraps the KVM_RUN ioctl, updates self‑test code to use it, and removes direct ioctl calls, simplifying test logic and avoiding duplicate error‑handling.
Adds support for background radar detection (zero‑wait DFS) on mt7915 by introducing new MCU commands, data structures, and driver functions, and integrating them into init and the ieee80211_ops.
Adds gamma LUT memory region definitions to RK3399 VOP device tree entries, allowing the kernel to control gamma correction on the hardware.
Adds a guard in kvm_pv_clock_pairing to reject the hypercall when the vCPU has tsc_always_catchup set, avoiding an infinite pvclock_read_retry loop.
Adds missing @server parameter description to kernel-doc comment for smb311_update_preauth_hash(), eliminating kernel-doc W=1 warning.
Adds six new Qualcomm SoC identifier macros to the dt-bindings header, enabling device tree support for QDU1000, QRU1000 and related variants.
The commit corrects the error‑handling check for platform_get_irq() in ipaq-micro driver, changing the condition from a null check to a negative‑value check, ensuring proper failure detection.
The patch replaces the three‑step thread creation (kthread_create_on_node, kthread_bind, wake_up_process) with the single helper kthread_run_on_cpu, simplifying rcutorture_booster_init.

The patch refactors the lpfc driver’s SLI‑3/SLI‑4 handling for RSCN/SCR/RDF/EDC/FARPR paths, replacing direct iocb field accesses with new generic get/set helpers and adding SLI‑4 specific sections, consolidating code and using local variables.

The commit separates VBT data into per‑panel structures, moves panel‑specific VBT parsing to the output probing stage, updates code to reference connector->panel.vbt instead of the global dev_priv->vbt, and removes an unused DRRS type check, improving modularity and maintainability.

The patch removes an unnecessary assignment to the variable 'bytes' in snd_echo_midi_output_write, leaving only 'sent = 0'. The variable was overwritten later, so the initial store was dead code, causing a clang static analysis warning.
Adds support for Intel Agilex DWC2 USB controller by defining platform‑specific parameters (disable clock gating) and registering the compatible string in the OF match table.

The commit replaces all spin_lock_bh / spin_unlock_bh and related *_bh lock calls with their non‑_bh versions across the rxrpc driver, because packet handling now runs in an I/O thread instead of soft‑irq context, making the _bh annotation unnecessary.
Switches the TI DAC5571 I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new callback, removing the i2c_device_id argument and obtaining it via i2c_client_get_device_id; updates driver struct accordingly.

The patch removes unused fields, tables, reset handling, DP‑specific code, and related conditionals from the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY driver, simplifying structures and eliminating dead code paths without altering functional behavior.
Adds a GCC_SDCC_BCR hardware reset in the sdhci-msm driver probe, using the reset controller API, to clear previous power states and avoid observed software reset timeouts during MMC initialization.

Splits the K210 timer nodes in the device tree, adjusts reg and interrupt ranges, and adds proper clock and reset references to match hardware, eliminating dtbs_check warnings about non‑standard interrupt lists.
Adds the 'qcom,msm8974-cci' compatible string to the i2c‑qcom‑cci device‑tree binding documentation and updates the description to list MSM8974 as supporting two I2C masters.

The patch adds loading of the actual VA bits (vabits_actual) into register x0 during the CPU resume path for ARM64 when VA_BITS > 48, ensuring __cpu_setup receives the correct VA size. This corrects boot failures on 52‑bit configurations such as Juno.

The patch modifies ssi_init() to store the return value of platform_driver_register(&ssi_port_pdriver); if it fails, it unregisters the previously registered ssi_pdriver before returning the error, ensuring proper cleanup.
The patch modifies bio_copy_data_iter to map both source and destination bio_vecs, copy the exact byte range, and unmap them, restoring correct handling of destination offsets that bcache relies on.

Adds optional reset‑GPIO handling to the onboard USB hub driver: introduces pdata with reset timing, parses OF match data, acquires reset GPIO, toggles it on power‑on/off, and updates driver structures.
The patch cleans up header includes in the 8250_dw serial driver: it removes unused of_irq.h and of_platform.h and adds the needed mod_devicetable.h, without altering driver logic.
The patch replaces a signed left‑shift (1 << i) with the BIT(i) macro to avoid undefined behavior when i can be 31, fixing a UBSAN shift‑out‑of‑bounds warning in __mdiobus_register.

The patch adds const qualifiers to detailed_timing pointers in EDID parsing callbacks, updating typedefs, function signatures, and related variable declarations to enforce read‑only access throughout drm_edid.c.

The patch updates the Intel tier policy check in the xhci driver to also block U2 link power management when U1 is disallowed, removes an obsolete early‑return, adds a combined debug message, and moves the policy check earlier to avoid unnecessary MEL commands.
Removes an unused return variable in rtw_wx_get_essid, simplifying the function to return 0 directly.

The patch modifies the condition that decides whether to start the ext4 lazy‑init request, moving the read‑only check out of the option‑dependent test so that on read‑only filesystems the lazy‑init thread is never started, avoiding unnecessary block bitmap prefetch.
The commit updates STM32 device‑tree files, renaming pinctrl node labels from 'pin-controller…' to 'pinctrl…' to align with the new pinctrl.yaml bindings and eliminate DTS node‑name warnings.
The commit removes an outdated maintainer email from the NTC thermistor devicetree binding documentation, updating the maintainers list.

The commit updates the kernel-doc Perl script to import Pod::Usage and replace its custom usage() calls with pod2usage, providing standardized handling of missing or unknown arguments and printing usage via the POD system.

Adds support for multiple clock consumers to the TPS68470 driver by introducing a consumer array in platform data, looping over it to register each consumer, and populating this array from ACPI consumer devices.
Adds a new SocketCAN line‑discipline driver (can327) for ELM327 OBD‑II adapters, accompanying documentation, Kconfig entry, Makefile update, and MAINTAINERS entry.
The commit adjusts the spacing in the heading row of the ext4 blockmap documentation table to align cells, eliminating a malformed table warning and allowing the doc to load correctly.

The patch updates the MMIO thermal driver to use the new generic OF registration API. It changes the temperature callback signature, switches the ops struct type, replaces devm_thermal_zone_of_sensor_register with devm_thermal_of_zone_register, and adjusts calls accordingly.
Updates the MT8365 mutex module array to reference the newly added DDP_COMPONENT_DITHER0 enum, matching other SoCs; the change is purely for consistency and introduces no functional behavior change.

The patch changes blk_crypto sysfs registration functions to accept a struct gendisk instead of a request_queue, updates prototypes, implementations, and callers, and adjusts inline stubs, preparing the block layer for future sysfs handling changes.

The patch removes an unnecessary spinlock around kernfs_walk_and_get, adds a lock‑free helper for default hierarchy cgroup lookup, and adjusts assertions, fixing a bug where a sleeping function was called while holding css_set_lock.

Adds the rockchip,enable-strobe-pulldown property to the emmc_phy node in the NanoPi4 device tree, re‑enabling the internal pull‑down for the strobe line that was previously disabled and caused HS400 I/O errors.
The commit extends the fsl_sai driver header to include DSD audio formats (DSD_U8, DSD_U16_LE, DSD_U32_LE) by adding corresponding format bits to the supported format mask.

Adds proper cleanup on error paths in the sun8i_a83t MIPI CSI2 driver: resources_setup now releases exclusive clock and returns error, and probe now calls resources_cleanup on failure, preventing leaks.
The patch renames several GPIO-related macros in gpio-f7188x.c by adding a f7188x_ prefix, updating all uses accordingly. This cleans the driver’s macro namespace without altering functionality.

Adds a best‑effort call to try_to_generate_entropy() in urandom_read when the CRNG is not ready, allowing the RNG to become initialized automatically on fast‑counter architectures, improving safety without making it mandatory.

The commit reorders initialization in the rtc-cmos driver so that cmos_do_probe runs before cmos_wake_setup, ensuring the driver data is set before the ACPI fixed event handler is registered, preventing a NULL pointer dereference on boot.
Corrects a spelling mistake in the MODULE_PARM_DESC string of the ioat DMA driver, changing "idel" to "idle" without altering code logic.

Updates comments and renames identifiers in mm/vmscan.c from 'page' to 'folio' to reflect the recent conversion of shmem handling to the folio abstraction, fixing inaccurate documentation and aligning code naming.
Updates the AD5380 I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback, removing the i2c_device_id argument and fetching the ID via i2c_client_get_device_id, and adjusts the driver struct accordingly.
Renames iscsi_conn_queue_work() to iscsi_conn_queue_xmit() across the iSCSI driver, updating call sites, exported symbol, and header to better describe its role of queuing transmissions only.
The patch replaces the atomic_long_cmpxchg loop with atomic_long_try_cmpxchg in __io_account_mem, removing an unnecessary compare and move, simplifying code while keeping behavior unchanged.

The commit removes now‑redundant validation and fwspec‑freeing code from various IOMMU release_device implementations, because release_device is only invoked after successful probe and core code handles fwspec cleanup.
The patch corrects a misspelled word in comments of three QIB driver source files, changing 'postion' to 'position' without altering any code logic.
Adds '#reset-cells' property with const 1 to MT8192 and MT8195 sys-clock device‑tree binding YAML files, documenting reset cell count for infra_ao reset.
Adds PCI device ID 0x3b57 to the HDA driver, enabling HDMI/DP audio on that Intel chipset by reusing existing driver capabilities.

The patch corrects how the self‑test clocksource‑switch harness interprets the return value of system(): it now uses WIFEXITED/WEXITSTATUS to propagate child errors instead of returning the raw waitpid status.
Adds tx_push support to ethtool ring parameter APIs, updating docs, kernel structs, netlink definitions, and handling code so users can get/set tx_push via ethtool -G/g.
Removes an unnecessary 'return;' from a void function in the VIA HDA driver, cleaning up the code.

The patch makes rcuscale independent of the RCU Tasks subsystem by conditionally compiling the tasks_ops code and removing the Kconfig dependency, updating test configs accordingly, thus avoiding unnecessary inclusion of RCU Tasks in PREEMPT_NONE kernels.
Adds checks for rxe_get() in tasklet functions to return -EAGAIN when the qp reference cannot be obtained, preventing use of a qp whose refcount has dropped.

Introduces dsa_switch_teardown_tag_protocol that calls tag_ops->disconnect to free tagger-owned storage during switch teardown, and invokes it from dsa_switch_teardown, fixing a leak that occurred on driver unbind.

The patch changes the io_kiocb structure to replace the existing hlist_node with a union that can hold either the original hash node or two new 64‑bit fields (extra1, extra2). These fields are used to store additional return values required for the CQE32 feature in io_uring.

The patch modifies the BPF self‑test script to generate unique temporary network‑namespace names with mktemp, replacing hard‑coded names, and updates all references accordingly, preventing name collisions.

The patch refactors the calculation of the module list size in audioreach_alloc_graph_pkt, removing a separate division and computing the size incrementally within the container loop, then aligning the total.
Adds a sanity check that prevents DSA master network devices from being linked to unknown upper interfaces, allowing only DSA slave uppers or bridge masters, to enforce correct topology for LAGs.
Adds qca8k_bulk_read/write helpers that use the management Ethernet path for bulk register access, and updates the FDB read/write code to use these helpers, reducing the register count from 4 to 3.
Adds a workqueue and mutex to query VHCA state and probe active Subfunctions (SFs) during driver initialization, fixing a regression where SFs were not recreated after driver reload.
Replace custom qed_set_coherency_mask with dma_set_mask_and_coherent, remove dead code, and simplify driver initialization in the qed driver.
Adds a Kconfig option and Makefile entries to enable building of the AMD RPL platform ACP6x audio driver, including a new Makefile for the driver source.

Updates arch/arm64/lib/strcmp.S by importing the latest upstream Arm Optimized Routines version, adding Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) support, adjusting big‑endian handling, register usage, and updating licensing.

The commit changes LPFC driver VMID handling to derive registration flags from fabric (FLOGI_ACC) parameters instead of static module parameters, adding a new flag and updating code paths that check priority tagging.
Adds dedicated interrupt handlers for RAS poison creation and UMC errors, and updates the main RAS interrupt handler to dispatch to them, separating poison‑creation handling from UMC handling.
Updates the maintainer list in the rockchip,rk3395-cru.yaml binding, replacing a former author with the current Rockchip clock maintainer.

The patch stops ext4 from incrementing the i_version counter for EA inodes, which use i_version to store part of their reference count, fixing a regression observed in xfstest ext4/026 when iversion is enabled.

Adds support for PSCI version 1.1 in KVM on arm64 by defining a new constant, updating the latest version macro, implementing a generic call handler with a minor version argument, and exposing the version through PSCI_VERSION to guests.
Replace strlcpy calls with strscpy in several misc drivers where the return value is unused, following kernel coding guidance.

The commit replaces the old .txt pinctrl binding documentation for Qualcomm MSM8960 with a new .yaml file that follows the DT schema, keeping the same semantics but updating format and naming conventions.
Adds a call to put_mount_options(sbi->options) in ntfs_fill_super() error handling, freeing mount options when superblock initialization fails, eliminating a kmemleak reported by syzbot.

The patch removes a call that sends SMU_MSG_EnableGfxImu when enabling system features, because this message is already sent elsewhere. It keeps only the unload message when disabling and not in s0ix, eliminating a redundant firmware command.
Adds a macro DEFINE_DAMON_MODULES_DAMOS_STATS_PARAMS that generates module parameters for DAMON statistics, consolidating duplicated code in DAMON_RECLAIM and DAMON_LRU_SORT.
The commit corrects the CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_TIED_OUTPUT Kconfig test by removing an embedded newline that caused a syntax error when /bin/sh is dash, ensuring the test correctly detects compiler support.
The patch deletes duplicated MT8195 mutex register definitions and updates the mt8195 driver data to reuse the existing MT8183 definitions, adjusting the struct accordingly.
Adds a guard in ceph_mds_client to stop retrying a request after the retry count exceeds the 8‑bit limit (256), preventing overflow of the MDS retry sequence and returning -EMULTIHOP.
Renames several io_uring request handler functions to follow a consistent naming scheme (prep vs issue) and updates all call sites accordingly, without altering logic.
Adds a NULL check around DLM connection cleanup in ocfs2_dlm_shutdown and always calls the shutdown routine, preventing a kernel crash when mount fails and no DLM resource was initialized.

The commit relocates the entire 'calcs' subdirectory into the 'dml' directory, updates Makefiles to reflect the new location, deletes the old calcs Makefile, and adjusts compile flags. No code logic is changed; the change is purely structural to isolate FPU code.
Adds a defensive re‑lookup of the data attribute when layout changes cause attr_b to become NULL, handling errors and marking the inode bad, fixing a crash in fragmented cases.

The patch fixes a memory leak in Btrfs backref walking. It introduces free_leaf_list to release inode lists attached to ulist nodes before freeing the ulist, and replaces the previous ulist_free call in resolve_indirect_refs error handling.
The patch corrects a duplicated phrase in a comment within spte.h, changing "be split be split" to "be split" without altering code logic.
Adds a static helper create_pidcomm in perf's timechart tool to centralize allocation and list‑linking of per_pidcomm structures, and replaces duplicated code with calls to this helper.

Fixes a rare bug in the RXE RDMA driver where read_reply() could use a NULL memory region (mr) during replay, causing the rping benchmark to fail. Adds a recheck of the MR when res->replay is true and returns an error if invalid.

The patch clears regulator_init_data when registering the vsys regulator, because that init_data is only for the vbus regulator. This prevents duplicate consumer supply names that caused regulator_register to fail, fixing the driver probe.
Ensures migrate_pages correctly handles -ENOSYS from THP/hugetlbfs migration by moving failed THP pages to ret_pages, preventing double counting and making error handling consistent.
Adds runtime‑PM wakeref handling in i915_pxp_tee_component_unbind so that intel_pxp_fini_hw runs with a held wakelock, fixing the "RPM wakelock ref not held during HW access" warning during shutdown.
The commit swaps the numeric values of PSP_BL__LOAD_DBGDRV and PSP_BL__LOAD_INTFDRV in the PSP bootloader command enum to align them with the definitions used in the trusted OS.
Changes IP/IPv6 header copy helpers to use __struct_group, fixing incorrect memcpy that caused compiler overflow warnings and aligning UAPI structs accordingly.
Adds a flag to track aborted in‑progress CEC transmits and updates transmit handling logic to avoid retries and buffer overwrites, fixing data corruption when a transmit is cancelled.
Adds Justin Chen as a maintainer for three Broadcom USB driver sections in the MAINTAINERS file, replacing Al Cooper as internal maintainer.

The commit extracts all timeout‑related structures, functions, and logic from io_uring.c into a new file timeout.c (with header timeout.h), updates the Makefile to compile it, and adds necessary prototypes, reorganizing the code without changing runtime behavior.

The patch renames the driver‑specific structure udl_drm_connector to udl_connector, updates all its usages, introduces a to_udl_connector helper macro for upcasting, and adjusts header includes. No functional behavior is changed.
The patch deletes two unused extern declarations of __arch_set_user_pkey_access from arch/x86/include/asm/pkeys.h, eliminating dead code that was never defined or referenced.

The patch deletes the static helper functions reg_from_user and reg_to_user in arch/arm64/kvm/sys_regs.c and replaces their usage with the standard get_user/put_user macros, simplifying the code without changing its behavior.
The commit modifies the DSA documentation file, fixing typographical errors, grammar, and punctuation to improve readability; it does not alter any kernel code or behavior.
Updates Documentation/process/changes.rst, replacing the hard‑coded "4.x" kernel version with the generic term "current" so the document stays accurate for future kernel releases.
Removes the unnecessary mutex lock/unlock around the bvalid IRQ handler in the Rockchip USB2 PHY driver because clearing the IRQ is atomic.
Aligns tcp_bpf_recvmsg_parser error handling with the TCP stack, adding checks for socket state, errors, shutdown, and timeouts to return correct error codes.

The patch updates alcor_pci driver to use ida_alloc/ida_free instead of deprecated ida_simple_get/remove and adds a missing ida_free call in the probe error path when pci_request_regions fails, ensuring the allocated ID is released and fixing a resource‑leak bug.

Reverts a recent change that populated the DCN315 clock table using DCFCLK values, because when DCFCLK states are disabled the firmware provides empty entries, leading to underflow. Restores previous logic that avoids using those values.
Adds a debugfs file amdgpu_reset_level, defines reset level bits, stores a mask in amdgpu_device, and uses it to enable/disable mode2 and soft‑recovery resets, defaulting to soft‑recovery only.
Fixes incorrect reporting of pending state for level‑mapped hardware interrupts in KVM's VGIC by reading the physical distributor state instead of the virtual state.
Replace direct bitwise operations with REG_FIELD_PREP and REG_FIELD_GET macros for PLANE_WM_BLOCKS_MASK in write and read functions, improving correctness and consistency.

Removes an unnecessary forward declaration of struct seq_file from include/linux/pwm.h, which was only required before a prior commit dropped the per‑chip dbg_show callback. No functional behavior is altered.

The patch refactors ipa_table_init_add() to take only two boolean flags (filter, ipv6) instead of opcode and memory IDs, computes opcode and memory regions internally via ipa_table_mem(), and updates all call sites accordingly. It also guards against missing hashed tables.

The patch extracts all devlink‑related functions and definitions from net/dsa/dsa.c and dsa2.c, places them into new files net/dsa/devlink.c and devlink.h, updates the Makefile to build devlink.o, and removes the duplicated code, thereby cleaning up the DSA core files.
Fixes a race in NR_FILE_MAPPED accounting for huge pages by initializing nr to 0 and moving __mod_lruvec_page_state() calls so updates are not missed, preventing spurious growth in /proc/meminfo.

Adds an issue_flags argument to io_try_cancel, io_poll_cancel and related functions, propagating whether the uring lock is held, and passes the appropriate flag from timeout handling. This enables correct lock handling during poll cancellation.
Adds the Renesas RZ/V2L (r9a07g054) Mali‑G31 GPU compatible string to the arm,mali-bifrost devicetree binding documentation and updates the schema to accept it.

Adds support for “high” userspace addresses in hugetlbfs by using arch_get_mmap_end/base macros and moving their default definitions to sched/mm.h, fixing a regression where hugetlb_get_unmapped_area could return addresses above the allowed range on ARM64.

The patch updates perf's printing code to pass a struct outstate pointer through various helper functions, changing signatures and call sites. It adjusts iostat and stat-display files to use the new argument, removing local struct constructions. No new functionality or bug fix is introduced.

The commit corrects diagnostic messages in the Habana Labs drivers by converting firmware-provided 32‑bit values from little‑endian to CPU endianness with le32_to_cpu() and prints the consumer index using %d after atomic_read(), fixing inaccurate log output for out‑of‑sync and packet‑failure events.
Adds support for AMD platforms by introducing an ACPI device ID table and linking it to the ucsi_ccg I2C driver, enabling enumeration of Cypress CCGX PD controllers via the system I2C controller.
Updates the aer-inject download URL in Kconfig and source comment to a current repository, fixing broken documentation links.
Introduces do_patch_entry_fixups() to replace duplicated loops that patch entry fixup instructions in several functions, updating calls accordingly. No functional change, only code consolidation.
The commit updates the MMP DMA driver to read the new "dma-channels" DT property, falling back to the deprecated "#dma-channels" for compatibility, and sets a default if neither is present.

The commit clearly updates the Mediatek clock driver infrastructure to use the newer `clk_hw_onecell_data` API instead of the older `clk_onecell_data`. All changes are systematic and well‑documented across the affected files.
Renames the DesignWare PCIe port structure from pcie_port to dw_pcie_rp across the driver, updating all declarations, definitions and function signatures for naming consistency.
Updates the DCN315 clock manager to build its bandwidth/clock table from DCFCLK instead of FCLK and adds checks so an empty PMFW table does not produce invalid clocks.
Adds a missing @ab parameter description to the kernel-doc comment of dump_common_audit_data, eliminating documentation warnings.

Fixes a typo in the sc8180x GPIO wake IRQ map where gpio37 was assigned the same wakeirq number as gpio36, preventing its interrupts. The entry is changed from 43 to 44, restoring proper interrupt functionality.
The patch only modifies a comment in drivers/net/ipa/gsi_trans.c, removing a reference to allocating command‑info entries that are no longer allocated. No functional code is changed.
Removes the regulator-always-on flag from the LDO2 node in the at91-sama5d27_wlsom1 device tree, preventing the regulator from being forced on at boot because no consumer uses it.
The patch lowers the severity of a diagnostic in i915 uncore code from a WARN to a debug message, because the WARN was triggered for harmless cases introduced by a previous commit.

Refactors KVM ARM64 VGIC attribute handling by moving common get/set calls into the default switch case, consolidating pending table handling, and deduplicating register access functions, resulting in cleaner, more maintainable code.

The patch changes the variable ret in tve200_modeset_init from being implicitly zero‑initialized to being explicitly set to -EINVAL before the error‑handling goto, removing an smatch warning about an ambiguous return value.
Adds support for a newly identified ADL‑S GPU by inserting its PCI identifier (0x468B) into the i915 driver's PCI ID table.
The patch removes the use of the __func__ macro from dev_dbg calls in the Intel SoundWire driver, replacing them with static text strings, simplifying debug messages.
Updates self‑refresh timing parameters (sr_exit_time_us, sr_enter_plus_exit_time_us) in watermark tables for DDR5, LPDDR5 and FPU structures to match hardware‑requested values for DCN314.

The patch makes the vfs_setxattr() value argument const-correct, updates its prototype, adjusts callers (overlayfs and cap conversion) to remove unnecessary casts, and updates the header. It reflects a code‑quality improvement after translation handling was moved out of vfs_setxattr.
Updates thunderbolt driver KUnit tests to use the new kunit_test_suite() macro, removes old test init/exit functions, and adjusts Kconfig to enable tests when KUNIT_ALL_TESTS is set.
Adds a helper that asserts no ordered extents exist in a given inode range and integrates it into fallocate, hole punching, zero range and reflink paths to catch unexpected ordered extents.
Rewrites i915 selftest threads to use kthread_worker/kthread_work instead of kthread_stop(), avoiding signal‑assertion failures introduced by recent kthread_stop() changes.

Adds command‑line options to the xdpsock sample allowing users to specify destination and source MAC addresses for transmitted packets, parses them, stores in static structs, and uses them when building Ethernet headers.
Changes the printk format specifier in xgbe driver from %hx to %x to match the promoted int type, eliminating a clang -Wformat warning.
The patch casts the upper bound of the branch offset check to long, ensuring a signed comparison and preventing false WARN_ON triggers for negative offsets in MIPS jump label handling.

The patch replaces the single spi_statistics structure protected by a spinlock with per‑CPU instances using u64_stats_t and u64_stats_sync, adds allocation helpers, and updates all accesses. This removes lock contention in the SPI hot path, yielding a measurable latency reduction.
Adds writes to CP and MEC interrupt control registers to enable the GENERIC0_INT field when IRQ state is enabled, allowing the RLC to receive interrupts for indirect register access.

The commit removes the unused reg pointer from the r8a73a4_cpg struct, makes it a local variable in the init function, and updates r8a73a4_cpg_register_clock() to receive the base address as a parameter, adjusting all register reads accordingly.

The commit corrects error handling in s10_ops_write_init(): it replaces a NULL check with IS_ERR() and returns the proper error code using PTR_ERR(), because stratix10_svc_allocate_memory() returns ERR_PTR on failure.
Adds a workaround that reloads eDP link rates from the sink when the Parade PS8461E MUX loses its cached rates, preventing unstable high link rates during link training.
Replaces hand‑written swaps of DMA descriptor pointers with the generic swap() macro, removing temporary variables and simplifying the queue_dma function in net2280 USB gadget driver.

The patch removes the HW_VAR_H2C_FW_P2P_PS_OFFLOAD case from SetHwReg8188EU(), calls rtl8188e_set_p2p_ps_offload_cmd() directly in the callers, and deletes the corresponding enum entry, simplifying the driver code.
Adds a validation check in the i2c-ismt driver to cap the user‑provided block length to I2C_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX, returning -EINVAL if exceeded, preventing out‑of‑bounds writes to the DMA buffer.

The patch fixes a naming collision in NVMe block devices when multipath is enabled and namespaces are shared. It initializes the 'shared' flag in nvme_ns_head before allocation, passing it via a new argument to nvme_alloc_ns_head, ensuring nvme_is_unique_nsid() works correctly.
Adds BPF selftests for __user pointer tags, introducing new test programs and harness code to verify that such accesses are rejected by the verifier.
The commit removes the SAVEKMSG_MAGIC1 and SAVEKMSG_MAGIC2 entries from the magic-number documentation (and translations) because they are not true magic numbers, correcting the documentation.

Changes tfp410_fini() to return void instead of int, updates remove callbacks to ignore the return value and return 0, cleaning up API because the function always succeeded; also notes future change for i2c/platform remove callbacks.
Adds a null‑pointer check for sta->rates in mt7615_sta_rate_tbl_update to avoid dereferencing a NULL pointer when minstrel_ht_update_rates fails to allocate the rates array.
Adds a new devicetree binding YAML file describing the LoongArch CPU interrupt controller, documenting its compatible string, interrupt cells, and example usage.

The patch adjusts batman-adv's handling of iflink indices, recognizing that ifindex values are not unique across network namespaces and adding explicit checks for iflink == 0 and self‑referencing links to stop recursion correctly.

Adds an INV flag for inverted MFSEL bits, updates pin configuration for scs3 and kbcc pins to include this flag, and modifies wpcm450_update_mfsel to invert the value when the flag is set, correcting the driver’s handling of those pins.

The commit corrects a compile‑time size check in the Mellanox kTLS TX driver by replacing the wrong constant TLS_OFFLOAD_CONTEXT_SIZE_TX with the proper TLS_DRIVER_STATE_SIZE_TX in a BUILD_BUG_ON assertion.
Adds a const qualifier to the 'path' parameter of do_sys_name_to_handle, making the function treat the argument as read‑only.

The commit replaces explicit dev_err() handling with dev_err_probe() in the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY probe function, simplifying error reporting and automatically handling -EPROBE_DEFER by setting a defer reason for debugfs.
The patch removes a duplicated word in a comment within bcache.h, changing "we we" to "we". No code logic or behavior is altered.

Implements a new GETVXATTR operation in the Ceph client, adding a function to request virtual xattrs from the MDS, parsing its reply, updating operation tables, and integrating it into the generic getxattr handling.
The commit deletes the unused irq_prepare_beacon_tasklet field from struct recv_priv in the r8188eu driver, cleaning up dead code.

Adds support for a separate headphone‑enable GPIO on the Intel SOF ES8336 board driver. Introduces a new quirk flag, GPIO descriptor, ACPI mappings, and logic to drive the headphone GPIO alongside the speaker GPIO.

Adds support for Qualcomm SM6125 display clock controller by adding a Kconfig option, Makefile entry, and a new driver file that defines clocks, PLLs, and power domains, allowing display drivers to probe and control clocks on SM6125 devices.
Adds a runtime warning in acpi_ex_system_do_sleep when the requested sleep exceeds 10 ms, alerting firmware developers to excessive delays that can affect boot time.

The commit modifies batman‑adv's hard‑interface code to replace an error log about a missing parent device with a warning and clearer text, because the condition is only a skipped sanity check, not a failure.
Adds a null-pointer guard in amdgpu_smu_stb_debug_fs_init to avoid dereferencing the SMU context when the SMU block is not enabled.

Adds a conditional restart of the NVMe admin queue after aborting outstanding I/Os; when start_queues is true the admin queue is re‑started, fixing a situation where the controller could not handle admin requests and caused I/O hangs.

Adds SO_RCVMARK socket option to expose SO_MARK as ancillary data on recvmsg, defines the constant for multiple architectures, introduces SOCK_RCVMARK flag, renames sock_recv_ts_and_drops to sock_recv_cmsgs to also send the mark, updates all callers and setsockopt/getsockopt handling.
The commit removes a duplicated word in a comment within rtllib_softmac.c, changing "new new" to "new" without altering any executable code.
The commit removes the OMAP debug‑leds driver, its Kconfig option and Makefile entry, deleting dead code that could never be selected.
The commit adjusts the underline lengths in Documentation/security/SCTP.rst to satisfy reStructuredText rules, eliminating 'title underline too short' warnings during 'make htmldocs'.

Adds the static qualifier to the cavium_erratum_23154_cpus array in arch/arm64/kernel/cpu_errata.c, fixing sparse warnings about the symbol not being declared static and limiting its linkage to the file.
The patch modifies vc4_hdmi bind to set scdc_enabled only when the hardware supports pixel clocks above HDMI 1.4, avoiding SCDC register accesses on Pi0‑3 which lack them.
Updates the lis3lv02d I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback, removing the unused i2c_device_id argument and adjusting the driver struct accordingly.
The commit updates two devicetree binding YAML files, removing interrupt flag cells from MDSS consumer nodes because the provider supplies a single cell, and adds a label to the MDSS node.

The patch restores proper initialization of the engine workaround list on Gen2-3 GPUs by always running the generic init path and early‑returning only inside the engine-specific helper, fixing a regression that left the list uninitialized.
The patch deletes an outdated comment in btrfs_search_slot() that referred to obsolete locking semantics, leaving the functional code unchanged.
Adds definitions for two new DPCD bit fields required for PSR2 support per eDP 1.5, updating drm_dp_helper.h and fixing a typo.

The patch removes an unused wrapper function for HDP RAS late initialization, updates the struct to call the core init directly, and fixes the call in amdgpu_gmc to pass the proper ras interface instead of NULL.
The patch removes an unnecessary cast from of_device_get_match_data() in the j721e PCI driver and changes the pointer type to const, simplifying the code without altering functionality.
Makes tcp_cdg_release idempotent by initializing and clearing the gradients pointer, preventing double‑free when tcp_disconnect is called on an already disconnected flow.
Adds allocation support for array controls in v4l2_ctrl_ref, renames dynamic‑array fields to generic array fields, and updates related logic to enable drivers to change array sizes.

Switches the Ethernet RMII clock source on DHCOM SoM from internal ETHCK_K to MCO2, updates pinctrl and RCC clock assignments, sets PLL4_P to 100 MHz and MCO2 to 50 MHz, improving SDMMC speed and reducing EMI.
Adds WARN_ON_ONCE checks in the Qualcomm QMP PCIe PHY driver probe to verify that the configuration provides pwrdn_ctrl and phy_status masks, warning if they are absent.
Adds an additional compatible string to the AST2600 EVB A1 device‑tree, allowing the board to be matched by drivers that look for the generic "aspeed,ast2600-evb" identifier.
Adds a lockdep assertion that the extent map tree lock is held in write mode before clearing the logging flag in clear_em_logging, ensuring proper synchronization.

The patch modifies RCU‑tasks trace code to ensure the currently running task on each CPU is added to the holdout list during a grace‑period pre‑step, by passing a list_head to callbacks, adding a preparation helper, and invoking an IPI handler per CPU.
Updates BMA400 driver macros for scale min/max to reflect correct sensor sensitivity per LSB, adding explanatory comments.
Fixes incorrect checksum handling for packets whose length is not a multiple of 4 by converting the extracted value to network byte order when byte swapping is disabled.
